'''Vorlo Stragen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked for the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. In [[3643 BBY]] Vorlo was tasked with the mission to stop the attacks at the Cartel's [[Spice/Legends|spice]] shipment from the [[Guiding Hand]]; for this he approached a [[The Barsen'thor|young Jedi Knight]] that had just defeated the leader of the Guiding Hand, the crazy [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Duras Fain]], demanding to have Fain handed to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] but the Jedi Knight was able to negotiate with Vorlo to let the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] have Fain in exchange for a large sum of [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] in compensation.
